data.standardized_narrative: No explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) could be located in the available pages of the PDF. The report highlights materially higher losses and loss adjustment expenses in 2017 and references three notable 2017 catastrophe events (Harvey, Irma, Maria) which contributed to the year's claims. Gross written premium for 2017 is reported in the accounts, but a clear, labelled gross prior-year reserves movement (or a usable gross claims development triangle) was not identifiable in the extracted pages.
raw_causal_phrases: Losses and loss adjustment expenses are GBP 123.1m higher than in 2016 resulting in an increase in the loss ratio of 9.1% to 70.4%.
These three CAT I losses equated to GBP 13.1m of losses by the three hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria.
data.data_quality_notes: The scanned pages provided are low-resolution and partly rotated. I could not reliably locate a labelled 'Claims outstanding' (gross) figure on the Balance Sheet prior-year comparative column nor a clear 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note with gross (insurance liabilities) column. A claims provisions movement table is present in the document but the scanned image made numeric extraction unreliable. The reported gross premium figure (199,896) was taken from the Technical Account / Profit and Loss page (values shown as GBP '000 in the statements) and converted to millions (199.896). Named 2017 catastrophe events (Harvey, Irma, Maria) were found in the strategic/management text. Because no definitive gross prior-year movement (insurance liabilities) could be located, prior_year_development fields are null. If you can provide a higher-resolution or correctly-orientated PDF (or the specific pages 20/44/45 in better quality), I can extract the required gross reserve and prior-year development figures and populate the triangle and LOB movement data.
